tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs phrin las kyi gter mdzod bzhugs// na maḥ shrī mahā kā la tsa tur bā ha we/ dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs phrin las kyi gter mdzod ces bya/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnyis med ye shes las/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mgon por sgyu ma'i tshul gyis rnam sprul pa/ /nag po khyod kyis rtag tu bskyang bar mdzod/ /dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis dpal mgon po 'di'i sgo nas phrin las bzhi sgrub par 'dod pas/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rim pas nyams su blang bar bya ba yin pa las/ 'dir ni bsnyen pa'i tshul gyis dngos grub blang bar bya ba yin te/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su mgon po'i sku dgram/ mchod pa lnga bsham/ gtor ma dpal bshos can 'bru dang sha sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ci 'byor pa bshams la/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas yi dam lha'i bsgom bzlas tshar bar byas pa'i rjes la/ rang gi snying kar paṃ/ a las pad nyi'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig sngon po can bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mgon po 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ yig las 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsgoms la/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags dang / phyag rgyas mchod nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chod thams cad nye bar zhi nas phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i siddhi ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥs tshogs kyi zhing du gshegs su gsol/ de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar po las byung ba'i gri gug gam ral gri lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam/

de thams cad yongs su 'gyur pa las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bka' sdod dam tshig gi mgon po nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi'u thung khros pa'i gzugs can/ sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can drag po'i 'od 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og mas g.yas ral gri g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /sgrub thabs ltar na/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can te gang mos su bsam mo/ /man ngag ltar bya rog gdong can yang bskyed par 'dod na/ g.yas su sku'i sprul pa gsod byed bya rog gdong can/ g.yon du gsung gi sprul pa/ srog bdag bya rog gdong can/ mdun du thugs kyi sprul pa sgrol byed bya rog gdong can te thams cad mdog nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can sku thung zhing rags la sbom pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ khro zhing gtum pa/ bya rog khros pa'i gdong can/ zhal gdangs shing khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum bsgrad pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra ser po 'greng ba/ stag gi sham thabs can/ sbrul dang mig mgo rlon pa'i do shal can/ rdo rje'i gshog pa bsdebs pa/ dbu la khyung nag gi sprul pa can/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od 'phro ba/ zhabs gnyis brkyang skum gyis bskyod pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad me 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros pas/ de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa gtso 'khor bzhi 'og min nam/ nā land+ra/ bsil ba'i tshal/ rdo rje gdan rnams nas spyan drangs par bsam zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje nag po 'khor bcas rnams/

/rang bzhin gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ badzra mahā kā la tsa tur hasta sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ 'og gi sngags kyi mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing / dbang du byas pas/ dam tshig pa dang / ye shes pa ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs mchod pas mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yum bzhis/ bdud rtsis dbang bskur/ sku gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gzhan rnams la ye shes mgon pos dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byung nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas mchod par bsams te/ so so'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra mahā kā la arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pa tyaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ badzra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi tya/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ thabs shes zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes sku/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i skur bstan nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las sgrub mdzad pa/ /nag po chen po khyod la bstod par bgyi/ /khyod kyi rnam 'phrul du mas phyogs kun tu/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis sgrub po rjes 'dzin yang / /nges pa bzhin du bsil tshal nā land+rar/ /rnam par gnas pa khyod la bdag bstod do/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams/ /bsrung bar dam bcas 'das dang ma 'das pa'i/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtso la 'dud/ /lha klu gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po dang / /sha za grul bum 'jig rten skyong ba yi/ /tshogs kyis yongs bskor dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ /rnam par rol pa khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i dbus gnas shing /

/zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab tu brjid pa'i sku/ /khro gnyer mche gtsigs skra ser gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar khros ljags 'dril khyod la bstod/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po gri gug gis/ /g.yon gyi dang po'i thod nang sha gcod cing / /'og ma ral gri kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ /gdug pa'i sha gcod dngos grub stsol mdzad bstod/ /res 'ga' dang po ral gri rtse gsum dang / /'og mas sgrub la mchog stsol mchog sbyin dang / /bde chen thod khrag bsnams pas phyag gnyis mdzes/ /sems dpa'i stobs kyis bzhugs pa khyod la bstod/ /gsus khyim rab che mig sman mdog ltar gnag /sbrul dang mgo phreng rlon pa'i do shal can/ /drag po'i sgra sgrogs stag gi sham thabs can/ /rol pa'i stobs kyis sgeg pa khyod la bstod/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi bka' gnyan 'khor gyi gtso/ /'jigs gzugs rngam zhal bya rog khros pa'i gdong / /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i khro gnyer rnam par gtsigs/ /zhal gdangs ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pas thod nang dam nyams khrag rgyun gsol/ /dbu skra ag tshoms ser po gyen du 'bar/ /sder mo rab rno mgo phreng can la bstod/ /sbrul rgyan stag gi lpags pa'i na bzar bcas/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis sa gsum kun/ /skad cig tsam gyis thams cad khyab par rgyug /nyin byed 'bum gyi gzi 'od can la 'dud/ /ces bstod la/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i thod pa'i nang du dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag ri rab dang rgya mtsho'i gtos dang mnyam par gang ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi yi ge gnas pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /yi ge gsum la thim pas/ 'od du zhu nas 'og gi sha khrag dang 'dres pas/

kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ ro mngar ba/ nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur te mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par bsam zhing / na maḥs manta kā ya wa ka tsitta badzra ṇāṃ/ na mo badzra kro dha ya/ mahā daṃṣṭo ta ka ṭa bhai ra bā ya/ a si mu/ sa la pa ra shu na bu ha ta ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhan dha bhan dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spho ṭa ya bi spho ṭa ya/ mahā ga ṇa pa ti dzī pa tā na ta ka ra ya hūm̐/ na maḥs manta kā ya wā ka tsitta badzrī ṇāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ maṃ maṃ haṃ haṃ kaṃ kaṃ ra ra mahā mahā kā ya piṅgor dha ke sha bhan dhe i maṃ ba liṃ grihṇa pa ya/ grihṇa pa ya/ i daṃ karma ku ru oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ sarba bighnaṃ bi nā ya kān/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ zhes sgrub thabs las 'byung ba'i gtor ma'i sngags kyis phul la/ sngar bzhin mchod pa lngas mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje nag po srung ma'i gtso/ /las mkhan bya rog gdong dang tsan ti ka /seng ge'i gdong can pho nya mngag gzhug pa/ /tshogs dang bcas te 'dir spyon dam rdzas bzhes/ /phyogs skyong lha klu gza' chen rgyu skar bcas/ /rgyal chen gnod sbyin 'phrog ma sha za dang / /ma mo lha min dri za mkha' lding bcas/ /'dir spyon mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes shig /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye grul bum dang / /srul po lus srul grib gnon skem byed dang / /'byung po 'khor bcas ma lus 'dir gshegs la/ /thugs dam bzhin du mchod gtor 'di gzhes shig /dgra bgegs khrag gi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ /dri ldan me tog gsar rnying sna tshogs dang / /sha chen la sogs bdug pa'i sprin phung gtibs/ /sna tshogs tshil dang tshil chen sgron mar bcas/ /khrag zhag thal chen byug pa maṇḍal dang / /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas ri rab tsam/ /yid 'ong zab brjid ldan pa'i rol mo sogs/

/sna tshogs mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes shig /ma sha 'bras dang 'bru nag so ba dang / /khur ba la du la phug 'dzam bu ti/ /bdud rtsi sman dang myos byed btung bar bcas/ /lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga yi tshogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas bdud rtsi dang / /ye shes rnam pa lnga ru byin rlabs shing / /sna tshogs rgyan dang lhab lhub kyis mdzes pa'i/ /bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sngon tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan snga ru/ /khas blang ji bzhin dam las ma 'da' bar/ /gtum mo'i bka' nyan 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /phyogs bcur bstan pa bsrung zhing rjes su skyong / /sgrub po 'khor bcas gzhan yang dam tshig can/ /de dag kun gyi tshe dang bsod nams dang / /dpal dang longs spyod mthu stobs dbang phyug rnams/ /rtag tu mi nyams 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /'dod don phun tshogs chos bzhin sgrub pa dang / /thos bsam sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong du 'phel ba yis/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ gang zhig bdag sogs bstan 'dzin la 'tshe zhing / /slob dpon la sdang bstan pa 'jig byed cing / /dkon mchog gsum la rgyab phyogs sems can 'tshe/ /kha 'jam sems gdug nag po'i phyogs 'dzin rnams/ /nag po khyod kyi mngon spyod las kyis ni/ /dgug rengs gzer bskrad sdang dang dbye ba dang / /rmugs dang bsad dang thal bar brlag par mdzad/ /de dag bstan 'dzin gnas pa med par mdzod/ /yang na de dag khyod kyis dbang bsdus te/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i las las phyir phyogs nas/ /bstan pa rjes 'dzin bstan skyong la gus shing / /bdag la dad nas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /chos bzhin 'grub pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba dang / /'jig rten ma lus bde skyid ldan par mdzod/ /'di las 'das na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas/ /de slad 'di las ma g.yel dam bcas dgongs/ /zhes pas phrin las bcol la/

rang dang mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ bsams la/ sngags phreng hūm̐ las byung / rang gi zhal nas 'thon mgon po'i zhal nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim nas/ mgon po'i thugs bskul/ hūm̐ las 'thon/ yang mgon po'i zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas mgon po 'khor bcas dbang du 'dus par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥmaṃ haṃ raṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ oṃ mahā kā la hūm̐ phaṭ ces dang / shā sa na bzlas/ thun 'jog khar gtor ma btang / gang 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas la/ cho ga lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na de la ye shes pa bstim/ med na gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /tshul 'di lta bus rtag tu gtor ma la brtson na bar chad bsrung zhing / dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no/ /tshul 'di sa skyar gnas pa yi/ /sngags 'chang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas legs par sbyar/ /dge bas 'gro kun bde gyur cig /nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs phrin las kyi gter mdzod ces bya ba/ 'di ni 'dun pa dang / dad pa dang / shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rin chen bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ legs par sbyar ba sa māptāḥ //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 bla ma dam pa/ dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
